description: This file defines a generic Cache interface for key-value storage with asynchronous and synchronous retrieval, invalidation, and modification methods, used within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A generic interface for a cache that supports asynchronous and synchronous get, put, invalidate, and bulk invalidate operations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a CompletableFuture that will complete with the value associated with the specified key, or an empty Optional.

methods.name: getIfPresent
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key if it exists in the cache, returning a CompletableFuture with an Optional.

methods.name: getBlocking
methods.description: Returns the value associated with a key synchronously, or an empty Optional if not present.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the cache entry for the specified key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Associates a value with a key in the cache.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Provides a thread-safe view of the cache as a map; modifications affect the cache directly.

methods.name: invalidateAll
methods.description: Invalidates a collection of keys in the cache.
